model_and_adapter.architecture: Pinned model config: bailing_hybrid/BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM,24 layers, layer_group_size4,128 experts,8 selected,1 shared; q_lora_rank256, kv_lora_rank512, no_kda_lora true; no MTP, no SwiGLU caps in tiny config.
model_and_adapter.load_route: Axolotl hooks redirect published configuration/modeling dynamic modules to its own training-ready Bailing classes. Published remote code is inference-only and has causal/padding-mask limitations.
model_and_adapter.target_guard: Match explicit attention-qualified names where possible; enumerate every trainable tensor and assert only LoRA A/B adapters are trainable. Do not add expert lora_target_parameters, all_linear, router gates, conv layers, embeddings, lm_head or modules_to_save for this pilot.
model_and_adapter.frozen_validation: Verify no base/expert/router parameters require grad and no frozen weights changed. Check no missing or unexpectedly initialized base weights on load.
model_and_adapter.fresh_reload: Fresh process must import Axolotl Bailing config/model, register _weight_conversions entries through Transformers checkpoint conversion registration, then load the exact pinned base with direct BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM and attach adapter with PEFT. Alternatively qualify the exact equivalent Axolotl loader hook path. A plain AutoModel trust_remote_code reload can select published inference-only modeling code.
model_and_adapter.expert_conversion: Bailing support registers DeepSeekV3 fused-expert conversions plus expert_bias -> e_score_correction_bias router renaming. Official tests explicitly register these conversions, test published expert-layout load and published-layout save. Direct fresh reload needs the same setup.
model_and_adapter.save_limits: Existing tests are tiny synthetic models, not proof real-model PEFT save/reload or Mac export. Check adapter save/reload separately; after merge/full save verify published per-expert gate/up/down key layout and expert_bias naming before MLX conversion. Record before/after hashes and fresh-process output equivalence.

template_and_labels.template_location: Pinned tokenizer_config has no inline chat_template; model includes separate chat_template.jinja. Preserve and hash this exact file with tokenizer artifacts.
template_and_labels.thinking: Pass chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking:false in training, development and reload. Template defaults thinking on, emits empty think markers when off, and preserves supplied reasoning_content. Omit reasoning_content and embedded nonempty think blocks for the nonthinking pilot.
template_and_labels.response_contract: Production structured JSON intent may be trained as assistant content; do not accidentally switch it to Ling XML tool calls. If native tool_calls are used, explicit message_property_mappings tool_calls:tool_calls is needed because default transform copies only role/content/reasoning_content; template expects arguments object rather than serialized JSON string.
template_and_labels.masking: train_on_inputs:false; roles_to_train:[assistant]. To train only the final target while preserving prior assistant context, configure message_field_training:training and mark prior context turns false/final target true. Inspect decoded label spans for every smoke row and representative pilot rows: system/user/tools/context masked, final target and intended EOT trained, nonempty labels, no truncation.
template_and_labels.termination: Model eos_token_id156895 corresponds role_end. Audit tokenizer EOS/EOT and label coverage; do not silently append a generic EOS or train observations.
template_and_labels.packing: Start unpacked for smallest compatibility isolation. Packing changes KDA recurrence and MLA masks via reset position_ids/cu_seqlens; before enabling it, require causal, padding and cross-document isolation checks for both branches. Existing source tests cover these paths but do not establish selected stack success.
template_and_labels.context: 2048 only if complete schema/system/context/target fit; otherwise measure required length. Never truncate gold or production schema to make smoke pass.
